scope: Current worktree against 53fd39f; defect record, fix report, WXT resolver, speaker hook, Cartesia 2.2.9 and object-inspect 1.13.4 source. No build, tests, UI, or Git mutation performed.

A_implementation_acceptance.supported: The import is dynamic inside ensureConnection, so module evaluation of useCartesiaSpeaker no longer loads Cartesia at sidepanel startup. The Vite resolver is limited to object-inspect/index.js requiring ./util.inspect and supplies an object whose .custom is undefined, matching object-inspect's browser:false intent.
A_implementation_acceptance.open: A fresh build must confirm the CommonJS transform consumes the virtual module and moves Cartesia out of the initial graph. Chrome must prove initial and repeated panel open, Settings and Scrape navigation, authenticated speech module import, audio playback and controls. The old output bundle is not evidence for this candidate.

findings.detail: If the speaker unmounts while getAccessToken, fetch, dynamic import or ws.connect is pending, the cleanup sees no websocketRef. The pending path later assigns websocketRef after unmount and leaves the connection alive. Guard after awaits and disconnect any newly connected socket on unmount; this becomes more likely with lazy SDK loading.

ensureConnection has no shared in-flight promise. Two speak invocations before websocketRef is set can mint two tokens and establish two sockets, overwriting the first ref and leaking it. SpeakerButton disables during loading after React state commits, but rapid reentry and other hook callers are not serialized. Make connection establishment single-flight.

B_code_quality.note: These lifecycle defects predate the candidate's final four-line hook edit, but affect the requested usable speech path. The virtual module is narrower and cleaner than the deleted CommonJS shim; it does not emulate Node util.inspect.
